content:
It's time for another round at the Apple Certified Refurbished Store, and we're taking another close look at the best picks this time around. We're not talking about a batch of scratched, suspicious Mac machines being sold at low prices on eBay, but rather products that have gone through Apple's "strict refurbishment process," offering the same one-year Apple warranty as a brand-new device, but at an even more affordable price.

If you're looking for the lowest-ever price on AirPods Pro 3 or AirTag 2, forget about it, but on the Mac side you can save several hundred dollars, and it's the lowest price for the latest models currently on the market. Let's take a look at this week's featured picks right now.

Apple Refurbished Store – This Week's Picks

***Apple Certified Refurbished product inventory is very limited

Chance – MacBook Pro

This week, I recommend keeping an eye on Apple's M5 MacBook Pro lineup. The price range for this series at the Apple Refurbished Store is extremely wide, starting from under $2,000 and going all the way up to nearly $9,000. There's a MacBook Pro for everyone in this lineup. Plus, one of the best reasons to choose a MacBook Pro over a MacBook Air is that absolutely stunning Liquid Retina XDR display.

  • 14-inch M5 MacBook Pro with 1TB storage and 16GB memory: $1,699 (original price $1,999)
  • 14-inch M5 Pro MacBook Pro with 2TB storage and 24GB memory: $2,719 (original price $3,199)
  • 16-inch M5 Pro MacBook Pro with 2TB storage and 24GB memory: $2,969 (original price $3,499)
  • 16-inch M5 Pro MacBook Pro with 1TB storage and 48GB memory: $3,059 (original price $3,599)
  • 14-inch M5 Max MacBook Pro with 8TB storage and 36GB memory: $6,029 (original price $7,099)
  • 16-inch M5 Max MacBook Pro with 8TB storage and 128GB memory: $8,499 (original price $9,999)

Zac – Apple Watch SE 3

What's the best price for a brand-new Apple Watch? The current lowest price for a refurbished latest-generation Apple Watch is the 40mm Apple Watch SE 3 GPS model at $209.

The refurbished version is $30 cheaper than a brand-new one with the same configuration on Amazon, and $40 cheaper than a brand-new one from Apple. It'll also support watchOS 27 launching this fall, making it the best way to get an Apple Watch at the lowest price without missing out on free updates.

Justin – Apple Watch Series 11

We've always loved Apple refurbished prices, as Zac mentioned above, and right now the Apple Watch SE 3 is indeed the lowest price around, but that isn't always the case, and the latest Apple Watch Series 11 is a completely different story.

Just a friendly reminder from 9to5Toys—yes, the Apple Refurbished Store does have deals on the Apple Watch Series 11, but buying a brand-new one on Amazon right now is actually cheaper. The 42mm Series 11 is originally $339 and the 46mm Series 11 is originally $369, but Amazon has up to $100 off both, so grab a brand-new one directly:

  • 42mm Apple Watch Series 11 starting from $299 (original price $399)
  • 46mm Apple Watch Series 11 starting from $329 (original price $429)

Ryan – MacBook Neo

If you need a new MacBook, the Neo is the model least likely to be replaced anytime soon. The MacBook Pro is getting an M6 model later this year, and the MacBook Air is expected to upgrade to the M6 in early 2027. But so far, rumors about the next-generation MacBook Neo have been scarce. If value for money is your top priority, the $599 MacBook Neo really can't be beaten. Unless you're doing some kind of professional work that requires a more powerful computer, for the vast majority of users, the MacBook Neo should more than meet your needs.

  • MacBook Neo: $599 (original price $699)
  • MacBook Neo with Touch ID: $679 (original price $799)
